title: Front Cover
content: Traditional fishers navigating an Amazonian estuary where interactions with the neotropical otter Lontra longicaudis frequently occur. This cover image relates to Research Article “Interaction between traditional fishers and the neotropical otter Lontra longicaudis (Olfers, 1818) in a Brazilian Amazon estuary”, [https://doi.org/10.1002/aqc.70274] by Marques et al. Photo credit: Dayse Marques.
